reason: The provided sources do not contain explicit evidence that the Vosges and Cevennes textile industries declined in the early 20th century, nor that Asian imports of cheaper textiles increased at that time and caused the decline.
supported: Source 7 mentions that the Vosges region was historically a major French textile producer, indicating the existence of a textile industry there.
not_supported: No source confirms a decline of the Vosges or Cevennes textile industries at the beginning of the 20th century; no source documents increasing Asian textile imports during that period; no source provides an explicit causal link between Asian imports and any regional decline; and there is no evidence about the Cevennes region at all.
evidence_needed: Historical data or scholarly sources describing the state of the Vosges and Cevennes textile industries around 1900‑1910, statistics on Asian textile imports to France during that time, and an explicit statement linking those imports to regional industrial decline.
